description:

Yet whether conversational AI improves visit readiness remains unclear. title: Unified Agentic Video Editing Across Levels of Complexity and Creativity
description:
arXiv:2609.12769v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Editing is a core component of video production, requiring creative planning and decisions under multiple constraints. Here, we report methods for agentic tooling for automated video editing across three tasks varying in editorial goal, complexity and creativity, namely scene previews, video summaries and cinematic trailers. We evaluate the outputs and discuss implications for automation and agency.

title: AutoHebb: Self-Modifying Neural Networks that Zero-Shot Infer and Continually Learn
description:
arXiv:2610.40757v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Humans and animals have a unique capacity to generalize and learn in novel circumstances, including "0-shot" inference (ZI) and continual learning (CL) -- two powerful cognitive abilities. Despite this importance, efforts to model ZI and CL are seriously limited in several ways. First, existing models typically lack components critical to ZI and CL in the brain, namely, strong inductive biases (for ZI) and autonomous control of learning (for CL).

In practice, an inference engine samples the responses and a separate trainer computes the gradients, and the \textbf{training-inference mismatch} between the two makes the training data off-policy. description:
arXiv:2610.40998v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Steering vectors (SVs) are residual-stream directions that shift the behavior of LLMs when added to hidden states at inference time.
